_note: cal-2 model choices (CAL2_PROPOSAL.md as amended by CAL2_AMENDMENT_1.md), fixed before the first cal-2 calibration run. Everything not listed here is as cal1_config.json. Only the three factors are calibrated.
name: cal-2
engine: breach_engine_2d_v3_3 options in breach_engine_2d_v3_2.py (V3.3: C1-C4) + fast_hydro/fast_morph Numba backend (C5)

_engine_options_notes.headcut_min_slope: 0.5 per CAL2_AMENDMENT_1 (proposal: 0.1). Scarp = run of cell-to-cell slopes >= 0.1 whose overall slope is >= 0.5
_engine_options_notes.collapse_phi_dry/wet: null = material friction angle (proposal C2); collapse_hswitch null = h_dry
_engine_options_notes.lateral_noncohesive: C3: lateral excess-shear law off for non-cohesive material; cohesive unchanged

f_kd.meaning: multiplier on jet-test kd (cohesive, measured kd only)

C_h.meaning: multiplier on headcut_C = 0.05 (energy method, scarp height)

runner._early_no_breach: for a case whose observation is a breach and that reports Tp: if the model has not detected initiation (crest lowered by 25 % of the notch depth) by 3 x observed Tp, measured from the model's t = 0, the run stops as completed (stop_cause 'no_breach_early') and is scored from its state then. Cases without an observed Tp, or observed 'no breach' (E1S3), run to their normal end.
